title: Delhi Sultanate: succession, rivals and lasts

boxes.title: Other successions
items: Khalji: Jalaluddin → Alauddin → **Shihabuddin** (child set up by ==**Malik Kafur**==) → Mubarak Shah
Sayyid: Mubarak Shah ==murdered **1434**==; Muhammad Shah died **1445**
Slave sub-phases: **Qutbi** (**1206-1211**), First Ilbari (**1211-1266**), Second Ilbari (**1266-1290**)
Sayyids claimed descent from the **Prophet**; Tughlaq = Turk (Jat mother)

boxes.title: Mongols & breakaways: more
items: Chengiz chased Khwarezm prince ==**Jalaluddin Mangbarni**==; Iltutmish refused him shelter
**Balban**: chain of forts on NW frontier; **Alauddin** completed the policy
Harihara + Bukka returned to Hinduism → founded **Anegondi**

boxes.title: More titles & facts
items: **Farid Khan** → ==**Sher Khan**== after killing a tiger
Mughal rule: **Babur**; Sur dynasty: **Sher Shah Suri**

boxes.title: More exam points
items: **Rajon ki Baoli**: four-tier stepwell, built by **Daulat Khan Lodi**; ASI + World Monuments Fund + TCS Foundation
